sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम् ।। ६.५९.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāmo dhanurādāya vīryavān ।lakṣmaṇānucarastasthau samuddhṛtya śarottamam ।। 6.59.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.
